slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the requirement to include exactly one of the three protein sources a hard constraint that must be satisfied, or is it a soft preference that can be relaxed if needed to meet the other constraints?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent referenced the exactly-one-protein constraint but only asked whether it was hard or soft; it did not explicitly ask whether exactly one protein must be selected or whether proteins can be combined. The exactly-one rule had already been volunteered by the user simulator in turn 1.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the requirement to include at least two of the four vegetable items a hard constraint that must be satisfied, or is it a soft preference that can be relaxed if needed to meet the other constraints?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent referenced the at-least-two-vegetable constraint but only asked about its hardness; it did not ask about the minimum number of vegetable types. The minimum-two rule had already been volunteered by the user simulator in turn 1.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL after only partially covering the two P1 hidden slots; it relied on user-simulator-volunteered facts about exactly one protein and at least two vegetables and never explicitly asked the underlying selection-rule questions.

summary: The agent asked several useful boundary and constraint-hardness questions, but it did not independently recover the hidden protein-selection and minimum-vegetable-type rules; it relied on user-simulator-volunteered facts and stopped with those P1 slots only partially covered.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
